title: U.S. 33 existing fiber
summary: Evaluate a lease of an existing fiber pair or an owner-operated circuit between the Watkins and Five Points tie-ins. The Delaware Avenue base crossing (FRA 513830W) remains on hold.

checks.label: Installed plant
checks.text: ODOT as-built GIS for PID 103719 shows seven 22 × 16 mm microducts and an existing 432-strand cable on segment 54.

checks.label: CSX property
checks.text: About 67 ft of the mapped conduit and crossing pullbox 87 overlap a railroad tax parcel. ODOT lists CSX as the rail ROW owner. This GIS overlay does not establish the limits of any highway easement.

checks.label: East handoff
checks.text: Scottslawn pullbox 130 falls in mapped road ROW. The original Watkins tie-in falls in a private tax parcel. Verify the recorded road easement and the full connection to the box.

checks.label: West handoff
checks.text: Northwest Parkway pullbox 85 and the Five Points tie-in fall in mapped road ROW. Verify the full connection and work area from the box to Fifth Street.

checks.label: What clears the hold
checks.text: Obtain the executed crossing agreement and signed as-built profile from ODOT District 6 and DriveOhio. Confirm commercial capacity, authorized connection points and maintenance responsibility with the fiber owner. Carry existing fiber as a candidate only if the proposed use can proceed without project access to CSX property. A new cable pull requires separate confirmation of duct capacity and installation rights.
